evidence.experimental_conditions: Human serum albumin (HSA) incubated with PPD; tryptic digestion and LC-MS analysis
evidence.support_text: In the present study, PPD bound to the single Cys residue on HSA existing in a reduced form (Cys-34). PPD modification of HSA at Cys-34 was characterized by the addition of 106 AMU on the relevant tryptic peptide, corresponding to the addition of a single molecule of PPD. Unlike previous studies, hapten-protein complex formation with other amino acid residues (for example, lysine and tryptophan) was not detected.

evidence.experimental_conditions: GSH-MDI reaction products co-incubated with human albumin
